name: KField
summary: A field: label, the control, one hint line, and the error tied to the control (aria-invalid, aria-describedby). Errors appear next to the control, never as a banner.

error.description: The refusal, next to the control.

children.description: Renders the control with the ids it is given.

notes: 16px text and 44px height on a phone.
The label stays visible while typing; never a placeholder instead of a label.

dont: Never show a form error as a banner.
